purpose: Phase 3 — Moderate Advisory Disposition (Task 3). Documents the disposition of every residual npm audit vulnerability after W3. Post-W3 npm audit reports 0 critical, 0 high, and 14 moderate vulnerabilities. W3 must record every vulnerability package with a disposition, owner, follow-up wave, and evidence. The w3 adversarial suite asserts these package identities match npm audit --json exactly and that no placeholder advisory rows remain.

drizzle_kit_floor.rationale: spec FR9 / AC2 forbids accepting npm audit fix --force recommendations to downgrade drizzle-kit to 0.18.1. The 0.31.10 floor in apps/bus-math-v2 is the pre-W2 baseline; the audit suggestion is unsafe because the older 0.18.x line re-introduces known issues. drizzle-kit advisories must be dispositioned as rejected or deferred to a future track that ships a proper 0.31.x+ fix.

disposition_taxonomy.resolved: A manifest, lockfile, or peer-bump landed in W3 that removed the advisory path.
disposition_taxonomy.deferred: The advisory persists; owner and follow-up wave are recorded. Deferred rows must be revisited by their owner before P5 closure.
disposition_taxonomy.accepted: The advisory is exploitable only in unreachable code paths; a written exploitability analysis is required in the row.
disposition_taxonomy.rejected: The advisory recommends a downgrade or workaround forbidden by spec NFR. Rejected rows are not auto-fixed; they remain in the audit report and are attributed to the wave that flagged them.

advisories.title: @cloudflare/vite-plugin vulnerable through miniflare, wrangler, and ws
advisories.follow_up_action: Resolve with the Cloudflare/Vite tooling migration when Vite 7→8 and related plugin ranges are updated.
advisories.evidence: npm audit --json after W3 reports @cloudflare/vite-plugin severity moderate, range <=0.0.0-fff677e35 || 0.0.7 - 1.37.2, via miniflare/wrangler/ws.

advisories.title: @esbuild-kit/core-utils vulnerable through esbuild in drizzle-kit chain
advisories.follow_up_action: Do not accept npm audit's drizzle-kit 0.18.1 downgrade; revisit when drizzle-kit ships a non-downgrade fix.
advisories.evidence: npm audit --json after W3 reports fixAvailable drizzle-kit@0.18.1 isSemVerMajor=true. FR9 rejects this downgrade path.

advisories.title: npm audit suggests downgrading drizzle-kit to 0.18.1

advisories.evidence: npm audit --json after W3 reports fixAvailable drizzle-kit@0.18.1 isSemVerMajor=true. spec FR9 explicitly forbids the audit-suggested downgrade; installed and declared drizzle-kit remain >=0.31.10.
